name: Exploded layers
shows: A real photograph taken apart into four sheets standing in perspective: the photograph on top, a halftone screen in the accent, an ordered dither in the ink and a plate of tone contours at the bottom; the halftone and the dither are printed on clear sheets. Up to four photographs can go in, one per sheet.
for: The one moment of a software page that works in layers or passes: imaging, design and print software, a map or a document tool, named in the client's words (its layers, its passes).
never: Never on a place, service, product or local-business page. Never named after the techniques (halftone, dither) on a company page: without the client's names it opens without labels. No caption that explains the effect; the photograph's credit goes in the footer's one credit line.
motion: None at rest: a neat stack a card's thickness apart, the photograph on top and the three sheets below as plain card, drawn once.
hover: The sheets open apart, their prints come up, and the stack leans toward the pointer; with names, each sheet gets a label on a leader line from a dot on its right-hand edge (where the panel is 560 px wide or more). Touch: tap opens, tap closes.
reducedMotion: One still frame; hover opens it at once, without easing.

params.names: four labels in the client's words, top sheet first; no labels without them (never the technique names on a company page)
params.labels: 0 hides the labels even with names
params.aspect: sheet width / height; default the photograph's ratio, clamped to 1.2..1.6

palette: surface for the contour plate and the faint tint of the clear sheets, ink and muted for the contours and the dither, accent for the halftone, bg for the ground; labels in ink.
cost: low: four textured quads, no MSAA (a soft outer pixel instead), 0.75 canvas px per CSS px in a large frame, drawn only while it opens, closes or leans
